hash_algorithm: sha256(file-sha256 plus two spaces plus relative path plus newline, sorted by relative path)

owner_authorization.scope: Direct owner instruction to integrate the Hourglass and Sherlock fixes after all CI/reviews pass, preserving artwork, canonical links and entitlements. Records the independently reviewed application source; not visual approval, deployment or a rights/access grant. Includes the existing compositor and mapping in the input set so editorial admission changes remain fingerprinted.

limitations: Source interaction transition only. Prior baselines remain immutable historical evidence. Reuses source-bound local responsive/keyboard/native200 QA; final exact-head CI and published review remain required. No production Reader acceptance, deployment or paid sessions.
